summary: Weekly usage shown as a pixel battery; spending knocks cells loose and resetting runs current along the cable until it is full.

events.name: use
events.description: Fires after usage is spent. `left` is the remaining fraction from 0 to 1.

events.name: full
events.description: Fires when a reset finishes and the battery is full.

methods.description: Spends 15% and fires `use`. Ignored while resetting or when empty.
Refills the battery over about 2.4 seconds, then fires `full`. Ignored when already full or resetting.

accessibility: The canvas has `role="meter"`, `aria-label="Weekly usage left"`, `aria-valuemin="0"`, `aria-valuemax="100"` and `aria-valuenow` as a percentage.
The percentage readout is an `aria-live="polite"` region. It is `aria-busy` while a reset runs, so the 5% steps are not announced one by one.
Both action buttons are native buttons with `aria-disabled="true"` while a reset runs; they keep keyboard focus.
motion: With reduced motion, a reset fills almost at once with no current along the cable and no charging wave, and sparks are skipped; spent cells still float away.
notes: The level is demo state starting at 64%, and the "Resets Monday 09:00" text is fixed.
The host carries `data-zone="low"` at 20% or less, `"mid"` at 45% or less, otherwise `"ok"`. The canvas is 92px tall.

data.note: The usage level starting at 64% and the Monday 09:00 reset time are invented; nothing can be set.
